headline: Papercraft hands over: slot a takes #3086 as the shelf dries a third time
lede: The TidyBot papercraft polish pass moved from the mini (whose hold went stale) to slot a, which reports all six polish items built with tidycheck green. Meanwhile the never-dry rungs came up empty again, so slot b logged a legal dry-shelf stop.

notes.text: #3086 (TIDY BOT papercraft polish) changed hands legitimately: mini's newest liveness went quiet past the 90-min line and slot a claimed at 05:29Z, checkpointing all six items — wavy gingham, cut-card attract, bot flute + tape, brass dials, confetti, paper sounds — with GOLDEN_PAPER re-frozen and tidycheck at 145/145.
#3091 merged: tidycheck's real-SPACE carry gates now wait on world ticks instead of wall-clock milliseconds, killing the flake where the harness swallowed both SPACE presses in slow runs (#3088).

Third dry read in a row: idle-kick returns NONE at d816805 — every flagship gap and every shelf gap is owned or held by QA (#3089 is the QA lane's). The new-flagship question stays capped by the 7-day rule until Nov 27.
